name: Royal Gold Sparkler 30cm
description: Our best-selling hand-held sparkler, dipped three times for an even, unbroken 60-second burn. The gold composition throws wide, soft stars instead of sharp needles, so it photographs beautifully and stays kind to small hands.
highlights: Triple-dipped for a 60 second continuous burn
Cold-glow tip — no loud report at any stage
Smokeless composition, safe for balcony use

name: Rainbow Colour Sparkler 15cm
description: Four colour bands packed along a single stick — green, red, violet and gold — that hand over to each other as the sparkler burns down. The shortest length in our range and the one we hand to first-timers.
highlights: Four colour transitions in one stick
Short 15 cm length, easy for children to hold

name: Electric White Sparkler 50cm
description: A brilliant magnesium-white sparkler with a dense, crackling corona. At 50 cm it burns for well over ninety seconds, which makes it the standard choice for wedding entries and cake moments.
highlights: 90+ second burn, the longest in our hand-held range
Dense white corona, excellent for video
Wire handle stays cool to the grip

name: Maharaja Sparkler 90cm
description: The showpiece. Nearly a metre of sparkler with a reinforced steel core, burning close to three minutes with a slow drift from gold to silver. Sold in fives because you rarely need more than one per person.
highlights: Close to 3 minutes of continuous burn
Reinforced steel core will not sag when lit
Gold to silver colour drift across the burn
images: GOPI Crackers/TWINKLING STAR/4 Twinkling Star (10 Pcs).jfif

name: Sparkler Family Tin — 100 pieces
description: A reusable printed tin holding a hundred assorted sparklers across 15 cm, 30 cm and 50 cm lengths. Enough for a joint-family evening without a single trip back to the shop.
highlights: Three lengths mixed in one tin
Airtight tin keeps sticks dry through the season
Works out to under ₹9 a sparkler

name: Cold Pyro Indoor Stick
description: A genuinely cold-flame stick used at indoor events — the spray sits around 45°C at 20 cm, so it will not scorch a ceiling or a tablecloth. Popular for stage entries and restaurant celebrations.
highlights: Cold flame, safe for indoor use
Almost no smoke and no sulphur smell

name: Deluxe Flower Pot — Big
description: The pot everybody pictures when they think of Diwali. A dense golden fountain climbing to about two metres, holding steady for 50 seconds before finishing on a soft crackle crown.
highlights: Crackle crown finish instead of a bang
Wide clay base will not topple on uneven ground

name: Colour Koti Flower Pot
description: Three stacked colour charges — green, then rose, then a wide gold finish — so a single pot reads as three different fountains. Our most requested pot for terrace celebrations.
highlights: Three distinct colour stages in one pot
Low smoke composition for enclosed terraces
images: GOPI Crackers/FLOWER POTS/Flower Pots Colour Kotti.jfif

name: Classic Flower Pot — Small
description: A modest 1 metre fountain that runs 25 seconds. Cheap enough to light a dozen in a row, gentle enough that grandparents will stay out on the porch to watch.
highlights: Great for lighting several at once in a line

name: Crackling Koti Special
description: Packed with titanium flitter, this pot produces a loud, continuous crackle that sounds like frying rather than banging. Visually the busiest fountain we make.
highlights: Titanium flitter for a dense crackle texture
Silver-white spray, very bright on camera
images: GOPI Crackers/FLOWER POTS/Flower Pots Colour Kotti.jfif

name: Giant Fountain Tower
description: A single tall canister fountain that throws a 4 metre column for a full two minutes, cycling through gold, green and crimson. Set it as the centrepiece and light everything else around it.

name: Pearl Fountain Assorted Pack
description: Twenty-five assorted fountains across small, big and colour variants, packed loose in a printed carton. The efficient way to buy pots if you are hosting a street.
highlights: Best per-pot price in the range
Carton doubles as a safe storage box

name: Ground Chakkar — Big
description: A hand-wound spinner on a balanced hub, so it holds one spot instead of wandering off across the road. Spins up in under a second and runs a bright 30 seconds.
highlights: Balanced hub keeps the spin in one place
Gold to green colour change at the halfway point

GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Deluxe.jfif

name: Ground Chakkar Special
description: A double-wound chakkar that spins nearly twice as long as the standard and throws a wider disc of colour. Finishes with a short whistle rather than a report.
highlights: Double winding for a 55 second spin
images: GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Special.jfif
GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Big.jfif
GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/4 x 4 Wheel.jfif

name: Mini Chakkar for Kids
description: A palm-sized spinner with a reduced charge — bright, quick and quiet. The chakkar we recommend when the youngest cousin insists on lighting something themselves.
highlights: Short fuse still gives 6 seconds to step back
images: GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Wire Chakkar (10 Pcs).jfif
GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Special.jfif

name: Twin Colour Chakkar
description: Two independently wound colour tracks fire together, so the disc reads as two overlapping rings — usually rose over gold. A newer design and quickly one of our favourites.
highlights: Two concentric colour rings at once
45 second run with a colour swap midway
Lifts about 30 cm off the ground while spinning

GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Deluxe.jfif

name: Chakkar Mega Pack — 50 pieces
description: Fifty chakkars mixed across big, small and special, packed flat in a single carton. If your celebration runs across a full street, start here.
images: GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Deluxe.jfif
GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Ground Chakkaram Big.jfif
GOPI Crackers/AMAZING GROUND CHAKKARAM/Wire Chakkar (10 Pcs).jfif

name: Lakshmi Rocket
description: The rocket that needs no introduction in Tamil Nadu. Straight 30 metre flight on a stabilised stick, then a single clean report at apex. Made to the same recipe we have used since 1994.

name: Colour Rocket Deluxe
description: Climbs to 45 metres and opens into a 12 metre chrysanthemum in green, rose or gold — one colour per rocket, mixed through the box. Almost no report, all picture.
highlights: Three colours mixed through the box
Soft break, far quieter than a Lakshmi

name: Whistling Rocket
description: A rising whistle that holds all the way up before a crackle break. Children track these by ear long after they lose them in the dark, which is most of the fun.
highlights: Crackle break instead of a bang

name: Two Sound Rocket
description: Two separated reports — one at apex, the second about a second later from a delayed charge. Loud, deliberate and a long-standing favourite of the cousins who only want noise.
highlights: 40 metre climb before the first break
Reinforced casing for a sharper report

name: Rocket Bomb Supreme
description: Our largest single rocket. Sixty metres up, a 20 metre gold willow that hangs in the air, then a deep report as the last stars fade. Needs real open ground.
highlights: Requires open ground — not for balconies

name: Sky Show 12 Shots
description: A twelve-shot cake with a single fuse — light once and step back for twenty-five seconds of alternating green and gold breaks. The easiest way to get a real fireworks display on a small terrace.
highlights: Compact footprint, fits a terrace corner
images: GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/12 Star Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/15 Multi Colour Shot.jfif

name: Sky Show 30 Shots
description: Thirty shots in a fan pattern across a wide arc, so the show fills the sky sideways as well as upward. Runs just under a minute with a rapid finale of eight shots.
highlights: Fan-angled tubes for a wide spread
images: GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/30 Multi Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/25 Multi Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/Bride Squad 30 Shots.jfif

name: Grand Finale 60 Shots
description: A properly choreographed sixty-shot cake: colour peonies, then crackling palms, then a twenty-shot barrage. Ninety seconds long and genuinely the last thing you should light.
images: GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/60 Multi Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/100 Multi Colour Shot.jfif

name: Emperor 240 Shot Battery
description: A professional-grade battery of 240 tubes fired as one four-minute programme. This is what we ship to temple committees and apartment associations. Licensed open ground and a marshal are mandatory.
highlights: Requires licensed open ground and a marshal
images: GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/240 Multi Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/520 Multi Colour Shot.jfif
GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/120 Multi Colour Shot.jfif

name: Peacock Fancy Shot
description: A single-shot fancy that opens into a wide, low fan of blue-green stars — closer to a peacock tail than a sphere. Breaks at only 10 metres, so it works where tall shots do not.
highlights: Low 10 metre break, good for tight spaces
images: GOPI Crackers/COLOUR FULL FANCY MULTI COLOUR SHOTS/Pea Cock Dance 30 Shots.jfif

name: Colour Smoke Pot Set
description: Six dense colour smoke pots — magenta, saffron, teal, violet, white and green — burning ninety seconds each. Entirely silent and flameless, made for daytime photography.
images: GOPI Crackers/SPECIAL COLLECTION/Colour Smoke Multi Colour.jfif

name: Atom Bomb Deluxe
description: A single sharp report with a long safety fuse. Batch-tested at our Sivakasi unit and held under the 125 dB PESO ceiling measured at four metres.
highlights: Single sharp report, under 125 dB at 4 m

name: 1000 Wala Garland
description: A thousand-cracker chain that runs about forty seconds once lit. Hang it from a first-floor balcony rail and it will still be going when the neighbours come out to look.

name: 100 Wala Garland
description: The short chain — around six seconds of rapid fire. What most families actually light at the doorstep before the lamp is placed.

name: Hydro Bomb King
description: A heavier report than the standard atom bomb, with a flash and a deeper tone. Still inside the legal ceiling, but this is the loudest thing we will sell to a household.
highlights: Deeper, heavier report with a flash

name: Bijili Crackers
description: Thin paper-wrapped crackers with a quick, high crack. The cheapest noise in the shop and, for a great many people, the sound of Diwali morning.
highlights: Lowest cost item in the range

name: Pop Pop Snappers
description: Throw them on the floor and they snap. No fuse, no flame, no matchbox needed — which is why they are usually the first thing a four-year-old is allowed to hold.
highlights: No flame and no fuse — throw to activate
Completely safe for very young children

name: Magic Snake Tablets
description: Small black pellets that grow into long ash coils when lit. No noise, no spark — just a slow, strange, extremely watchable transformation.
highlights: Grows a 20 cm ash coil per tablet
images: GOPI Crackers/MATCH BOX/Colour Matches Super Deluxe (10 in 1).jfif

name: Colour Smoke Sticks
description: Hand-held smoke sticks in five colours, thirty seconds each. Silent and cool-burning, they turn an ordinary courtyard into something worth photographing.
highlights: Great for daytime and group photos

name: Ground Butterfly
description: A tiny paper novelty that spins on the ground and lifts a few inches while throwing coloured sparks, like a butterfly that cannot quite decide to leave.
highlights: Spins and hops a few inches off the ground

name: Magic Whip Pencils
description: Pencil-thin sticks that throw a fine, low spray of white sparks for around fifteen seconds. Held like a sparkler but far gentler, and impossible to run out of.
highlights: Fine low spray, gentler than a sparkler
images: GOPI Crackers/TWINKLING STAR/1½ Twinkling Star (10 Pcs).jfif

name: Kids Fun Hamper
description: Every silent and low-noise item we make, packed into one printed hamper — snappers, snakes, smoke sticks, whips, butterflies, mini chakkars and three sparkler lengths. Nothing in it goes bang.
highlights: Nine item types, all low or zero noise
Nothing in the hamper produces a report
Printed contents list inside the lid

name: Classic Gift Box — 30 items
description: A balanced thirty-item assortment across sparklers, pots, chakkars and a few rockets, packed in a printed rigid box with the full list inside the lid. The safe answer for office gifting.
highlights: Rigid printed box, gift-ready as shipped
Contents list printed inside the lid
